blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: We test whether large language models solve formally matched kinship problems equally well when relations are expressed in familiar vocabulary or by explicitly defined nonce predicates. Across 500 paired graphs, concrete accuracy exceeds arbitrary accuracy by 35.6 percentage points in local Qwen3.8-27B, 26.6 in Gemma 4 26B-A4B, 12.0 in Gemma 4 31B, and 5.4 in Qwen3.8-Max. All four paired gaps are statistically resolved. Reasoning budgets and prompt-language interventions can substantially reduce the difference, showing that it is modifiable rather than a fixed incapacity. The minimal conclusion is behavioral: on these tasks, the models’ manifested relational competence is not indifferent to presentation. Explicit definitions provide the formal relations but do not make nonce predicates as usable as familiar vocabulary embedded in learned linguistic associations.
blocks.zh: 我们检验大语言模型在以熟悉的词汇表达关系时,或用明确界定的非ce 上游词,是否同样妥善地解决了正式匹配的亲属关系问题。 在500对图中,混凝土精度超过任意精度,在局部Quen3.8-27B中为35.6个百分点,在Gemma 4 26B-A4B中为26.6个百分点,在Gemma 4 31B中为12.0个百分点,在Quen3.8-Max中为5.4个百分点. 所有四个对齐的差距在统计学上都得到了解决。 合理的预算和即时语言干预可以大大减少这种差异,表明这种差异是可以改变的,而不是固定的丧失能力。 最低结论是行为性:在这些任务上,模型所表现的关系能力对表述并非无动于衷. 明确的定义提供了正式关系,但并不使非ce 上游语像嵌入在所学语言协会中的熟悉词汇一样可用。

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: Relational reasoning is often tested by asking a model to follow a chain of stated facts. Consider a reasoner whose competence is indifferent to the representation of those facts. Once told that wug(x,y) means that x x and y y are siblings and nuk(x,y) means that x x is a parent of y y , it should be able to compose wug(Julia,Ben) and nuk(Ben,Eric) just as it composes “Julia and Ben are siblings; Ben is Eric’s parent.” The symbols differ, but the stipulated relations and required composition do not.
blocks.zh: 关系推理往往通过要求模型跟随一系列陈述的事实来检验. 考虑一个理由,其权限对陈述这些事实无动于衷。 一旦被告知wug(x,y)的意思是xx和y是兄弟姐妹,nuk(x,y)的意思是xx是y的家长,它应该能够像它所编的“Julia和Ben是兄弟姐妹;Ben是Eric的家长”一样,组成wug(Julia,Ben)和nuk(Ben,Eric). 符号不同,但规定的关系和所需构成并不相同。

blocks.en: This yields a direct behavioral prediction. Holding the graph, query, and answer fixed, a presentation-indifferent competence should not systematically succeed more often in one vocabulary than the other. Equality would not by itself prove an invariant internal algorithm, but a reliable paired difference is enough to reject presentation-indifference for the competence manifested in the task. The relevant contrast is not between meaningful and undefined symbols. The nonce predicates are explicitly defined. It is between familiar expressions that participate in a rich network of learned linguistic and inferential associations and predicates whose task-relevant content is supplied by a local stipulation.
blocks.zh: 这会产生直接的行为预测. 保持图表、查询和回答固定不变,列报无差别的能力不应在一个词汇中比另一个词汇更系统地取得成功。 平等本身并不会证明是一种变化无常的内部算法,但可靠的对等差异就足以否定对任务中所表现的能力的表率暗示。 相关的对比不是在有意义的符号和未定义符号之间. 非ce的上游有明确的定义. 它介于一种熟悉的表达方式之间,这种表达方式由丰富的学习语言和暗示性协会网络和由当地规定提供的任务相关内容的上游组织组成。

blocks.en: We examine this difference on 500 paired synthetic kinship graphs. Each graph has a concrete rendering with ordinary relation terms and an arbitrary rendering with nonce predicates whose meanings are explicitly defined. The queried people and correct English answer are the same. The task is not memorization of a particular graph, nor does it ask the model to infer the definitions of unknown signs. It asks whether a known relational composition transfers across two ways of stating the same facts.
blocks.zh: 我们在500对合成亲缘关系图上研究了这种差异。 每个图都有一个带有普通关系术语的混凝土渲染,和一个具有明确定义含义的非ce 上游的任意渲染. 被询问者和正确的英语答案是一样的。 任务不是纪念某个特定的图,也不是要求模型推断未知征兆的定义. 缔约国询问,已知的关系构成是否通过两种方式转移了同一事实。

blocks.en: The central result is a concrete–arbitrary gap : all four tested models answer more of the concrete prompts correctly when giving an answer without a visible intermediate analysis. The gap is large in the two locally hosted models and remains detectable in a hosted model that is near ceiling. Thus, for these models and problems, relational competence is not indifferent to presentation. This conclusion concerns the whole process of reading, composing, and answering. It does not entail that every latent operation is content-dependent: an invariant composition procedure downstream of a presentation-sensitive interpretation stage remains possible.
blocks.zh: 中心结果是混凝土-任意差距:所有四个测试过的模型在给出一个答案时没有明显的中间分析,都会正确回答更多的混凝土提示. 在当地托管的两种模型中差距很大,在接近天花板的托管模型中仍然可以探测到。 因此,对于这些模式和问题,关系能力对表述并非无动于衷。 这一结论涉及阅读、组织和答复的整个过程。 这并不要求每个潜在操作都取决于内容:在对列报有敏感认识的解释阶段的下游仍有可能采用变化无常的构成程序。

blocks.en: We also ask how stable the gap is. Providing a dedicated reasoning budget often reduces it; displaying the set of English relation terms or requesting a coded answer can alter it even without a thinking channel. Those manipulations are valuable precisely because they show that the gap is not an immutable incapacity. They do not make its initial occurrence less real. The organizing question of this paper is therefore where and under what presentation the gap appears , with its repair treated as evidence about the conditions of access to relational competence.
blocks.zh: 我们还询问差距如何稳定。 提供专用推理预算往往会减少它;显示一套英语关系术语或请求编码解答即使没有思维通道也能改变它. 这些操纵行为很有价值,因为它们表明,这种差距不是不可改变的无能。 它们并没有降低其最初发生的真实性。 因此,本文件的编排问题在于差距出现在什么地方,在什么表述下出现差距,对差距的修复被视为获得关系能力条件的证据。

blocks.en: 2 Related Work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en: Large language models show analogical performance on novel tasks ( Webb et al., 2023 ) , complicating a simple recollection account. Yet linguistic and semantic content affects reasoning ( Lampinen et al., 2024 ) ; counterfactual task variants challenge unrestricted transfer ( Wu et al., 2024 ; Lewis and Mitchell, 2024 ) ; and the encoding of formally similar graph information matters ( Fatemi et al., 2024 ) . A paired presentation test isolates a particularly clear case: the relations are defined, the graph is held fixed, and the output question is shared.
blocks.zh: 大型语言模型在新任务上表现出模拟性能(Webb et al., 2023),使一个简单的回忆账户变得复杂. 然而语言和语义内容会影响推理(Lampinen等人,2024年),反事实任务变体质疑不受限制的转移(Wu等人,2024年;Lewis和Mitchell,2024年),以及正式相似的图表信息事项的编码(Fatemi等人,2024年). 配对的演示文稿测试将一个特别明显的情况隔离:关系被定义,图被固定,输出问题被共享.

blocks.en: Additional inference-time computation can improve model answers ( Wei et al., 2022 ) , but a generated reasoning trace is not a transparent record of the hidden computation ( Turpin et al., 2023 ; Jacovi and Goldberg, 2020 ) . We consequently treat reasoning budget as an operational intervention and answer-channel elaboration as a protocol feature. Neither a native “thinking off” switch nor an empty separate reasoning field alone establishes that a response was answer-only.
blocks.zh: 额外的推论时间计算可以改进模型答案 (Wei等人,2022年),但生成的推理追踪并不是隐藏计算的透明度记录(Turpin等人,2023年;Jacovi和Goldberg,2020年). 因此,我们把推理预算视为一种业务干预,把答复渠道的拟订视为一项议定书。 无论是本地的“思索关闭”开关,还是空洞的单独推理领域都无法确定只回答问题。

blocks.en: 3 Task and Evaluation
blocks.zh: 3 任务和评价

blocks.en: 3.1 Paired kinship graphs
blocks.zh: 3.1 佩尔德亲属关系图

blocks.en: The redesigned-v3 dataset contains 500 generated graphs, each with concrete and arbitrary prompts. Fifteen target relations span grandchild, avuncular, niece/nephew, cousin, great-avuncular, and marriage-linked families. Primitive facts concern directed parenthood, symmetric siblinghood and marriage, and gender; the benchmark adopts deliberately simplified conventions. Target classes are nearly balanced. The preidentified 434-graph subset excluding great-aunt/uncle is a sensitivity analysis, not a replacement for the full set.
blocks.zh: 重新设计的v3数据集包含500个生成的图表,每个都有混凝土和任意的提示. 15个目标关系包括外孙、外孙、侄女/侄女、表亲、外孙和与婚姻有关的家庭。 原始事实涉及直接的亲子关系、对称的亲子关系和婚姻以及性别;该基准采用了有意简化的公约。 目标课程几乎是平衡的。 预先确定的434图子集,不包括大姨母/大姨母是灵敏度分析,而不是取代全集.

blocks.en: An actual matched pair (graph kn-0062 ) makes the manipulation plain. The concrete prompt states: “Julia is female. Ben is male. Eric is male. Ben is a parent of Eric. Julia and Ben are siblings. What is Julia’s relationship to Eric?” The arbitrary prompt states: “ nuk(x,y) means x is a parent of y; wug(x,y) means x and y are siblings; tor(x,y) means x and y are married. nuk(Ben,Eric) , wug(Julia,Ben) ,” together with the same gender facts and question. Both require aunt . The third, unused predicate definition is included by the task renderer, not introduced only in the arbitrary answer.
blocks.zh: 实际配对的配对(graph kn-0062 )使操纵变得平坦. 具体提示说:“Julia是女性。 本为雄. 埃里克为男性. 本是埃里克的父母,茱莉亚和本是兄弟姐妹. Julia与Eric有何关系? 任意的提示表示:“nuk(x,y)表示x是y的父母;wug(x,y)表示x,y是兄弟姐妹;tor(x,y)表示x,y是已婚。 nuk(Ben,Eric),wug(Julia,Ben),“连同同样的性别事实和问题。 两者都需要阿姨 第三,未使用的上游定义被任务渲染器所包括,而不只是在任意回答中引入.

blocks.en: The pairing fixes the underlying graph, named query, primitive denotations, and gold relation. It does not hold surface length, syntax, or every fact position fixed: definitions lengthen arbitrary prompts, and the two renderings can shuffle facts independently. The reported effect is therefore the effect of this presentation package , not a pure substitution of one token string for another. Crucially, the arbitrary condition supplies ordinary-English definitions. The model need not infer the predicates from examples; it must use their stipulated meanings in the required composition.
blocks.zh: 配对修正了基础图,命名查询,原始解码,以及金关系. 它不持有表面长度,语法,或每个固定的事实位置:定义延长任意的提示,两种渲染可以独立洗涤事实. 因此,报告的效果是这一演示文稿的效果,而不是将一个符号串完全替换为另一个符号串。 关键是,任意条件提供普通-英语定义. 该模型不需要从实例中推断出上游;它必须在所要求的构成中使用其规定的含义。

blocks.en: We operationalize presentation-indifference by the minimal null hypothesis H PI : 𝔼 g ​ [ Y g C − Y g A ] = 0 , H_{\mathrm{PI}}:\quad\mathbb{E}_{g}[Y_{g}^{\mathrm{C}}-Y_{g}^{\mathrm{A}}]=0, (1) where the expectation is over matched graphs. This is a claim about successful performance by the complete system under the two explicit presentations. It is weaker than a claim that all processing stages must be identical and stronger than the claim that some downstream operation could, in principle, be invariant after successful interpretation.
blocks.zh: 我们用最小的空假说 HPI 来操作演示 - 暗示 : E g [Y g C - Y g A] = 0, H_{\ mathrm{PI}}:\quad\ mathbb{E}_{g} [Y_{ g}^{\ mathrm{C}}-Y_{g}^{\ mathrm{A}}] = 0, 其中期望值超过图表. 这是关于两个明确列报下整个系统成功履约的说法。 这比以下主张要弱:所有处理阶段必须完全相同,而且比某些下游作业在成功解释后原则上可能无变化的说法更有力。

blocks.en: 3.2 Models and answer-only protocols
blocks.zh: 3.2 模式和只答协议

blocks.en: We test locally hosted Qwen3.8-27B-AWQ-INT4 through vLLM 0.29.0 ( Qwen Team, 2026 ; Avyukth, 2026 ; Kwon et al., 2023 ) , Gemma 4 26B-A4B and dense Gemma 4 31B through llama.cpp b10917/Vulkan ( Google DeepMind, 2026a ; Google DeepMind, 2026b ; llama.cpp contributors, 2026 ) , and hosted Qwen3.8-Max ( Alibaba Cloud, 2026 ) . The local device is an RTX 3090. Temperature is 1.0, top- p p 0.95, top- k k 20, and the numerical seed label is 20260914 in the main cells. Shared seed labels do not imply shared random draws across backends.
blocks.zh: 我们通过 vLLM 0.29.0 (Quen Team, 2026; Avyukth, 2026; Kwon et al., 2023), Gemma 4 26B-A4B和 稠密 Gemma 4 31B 通过 lama.cpp b10917/Vulkan(Google DeepMind, 2026a; Google DeepMind, 2026b; lama.cpp 撰稿人, 2026)在当地测试Qwen3.8-27B-AWEWQ-INT4, 并主持 Qune3.8-Max(阿里巴巴云,2026年). 本地设备为RTX 3090型. 温度为1.0,顶部-p0.95,顶部-kk 20,主细胞的数值种子标签为20260914. 共享种子标签并不意味着共享随机抽取横跨后端.

blocks.en: The lead result uses observed answer-only outputs. For local Qwen and Gemma 26B, we ran new strict whole-response cells: the dedicated reasoning channel was disabled, the instruction requested only one canonical relation, and the completion allowance was 16 tokens. The entire response—not just its final line—was scored. The 1,000 outputs in each cell had no multiline answer, separate reasoning trace, or truncation. Gemma 31B’s repaired off cell and Qwen-Max’s off cell retained their original, more generous envelopes and final-line scoring, but all recorded responses were single-line and had no separate reasoning trace. These are two different protocol types, displayed separately in the lead figure. A single-word answer does not show an absence of internal computation; it only rules out visible answer-channel deliberation.
blocks.zh: 牵头成果使用观察到的只回答产出。 对于本地的Quen和Gemma 26B,我们运行了新的严格的全响应细胞:专用推理通道被禁用,指令只要求一个犬科关系,完成津贴为16个符. 整个反应——不仅仅是其最后的一线——都得分。 每个单元格的1 000个产出没有多行答案,没有单独的推理跟踪,也没有截断。 Gemma 31B的修复关闭了囚室,Quen-Max的关闭囚室保留了原来的更慷慨的信封和终线评分,但所有录制的答复都是单行的,没有单独的推理痕迹. 它们是两种不同的协议类型,在主图中单独显示. 单词答案并不显示缺乏内部计算;它只排除了可见的答案-通道审议.

blocks.en: For each graph g g let Y g C Y_{g}^{\mathrm{C}} and Y g A Y_{g}^{\mathrm{A}} indicate conservative correctness. The paired gap is G = 1 500 ​ ∑ g = 1 500 ( Y g C − Y g A ) . G=\frac{1}{500}\sum_{g=1}^{500}(Y_{g}^{\mathrm{C}}-Y_{g}^{\mathrm{A}}). (2) Invalid, noncanonical, truncated, and request-error answers count as failures. We give two-sided exact McNemar tests and 10,000-resample graph-bootstrap 95% intervals. Graphs, not 1,000 separate responses, are the sampling units. These intervals describe variation over generated graphs and not over seeds, model checkpoints, or independent datasets.
blocks.zh: 对于每个图gg,让Yg C Y_{g}^{\mathrm{C}}和Yg A Y_{g}^{\mathrm{A}}表示保守正确性. 配对差距为G = 1 500 ∑ g = 1 500 (Y g C – Y g A ). (Y_{g}^{\mathrm{C}}-Y_{g}^{\mathrm{A}}}). (2)无效的,非无效的,截断的,和请求-错误的回答算作失败. 我们给出了两面精确的麦克尼玛测试 和10000反光图 -波茨图 95%的间隔。 图,不是1000个单独的答复,是采样单位. 这些间隔描述的是生成的图表上的差异,而不是种子、示范检查站或独立数据集上的差异。

blocks.en: 4 The Concrete–Arbitrary Gap
blocks.zh: 4 混凝土-仲裁差距

blocks.en: Figure 1: Paired concrete-minus-arbitrary accuracy on the same 500 graphs per model. Diamonds denote strict whole-response reruns; circles denote original off cells whose saved outputs were observationally answer-only. Intervals resample graphs. Marker types flag distinct protocols, not model architectures.
blocks.zh: 图 1:每个型号上同一500个图上的Paired混凝土-减去任意精度. 钻石表示严格的全响应重排;圆圈表示原单元格,其节省的输出只按观察回答。 间断重现图. 标记类型为旗帜鲜明的协议,而非模型架构.

blocks.en: Figure 1 shows a positive gap in every model. Table 1 gives the component accuracies, uncertainty, and paired discordances. Local Qwen has 203 graphs solved only in concrete form against 25 solved only in arbitrary form; Gemma 26B has 135 against 2. Even Qwen-Max, at 93.0% arbitrary accuracy, has 32 concrete-only against 5 arbitrary-only successes. Exact McNemar p p -values are respectively 7.71 × 10 − 36 7.71\times 10^{-36} , 1.09 × 10 − 37 1.09\times 10^{-37} , 5.87 × 10 − 15 5.87\times 10^{-15} , and 7.43 × 10 − 6 7.43\times 10^{-6} . A four-test Holm correction does not change the inference that each paired gap differs from zero.
blocks.zh: 图1显示每个模型存在正差。 表1列出了各组成部分的精度、不确定性和对称不和。 本地 Quen 有 203 个 图形 仅 以 具体 形式 解决 25 个 仅 以 任意 形式 解决 ; Gemma 26B 则 135 个 反对 。 2. 即使Quen-Max以93.0%的任意准确率,也只有32个混凝土与5个任意的成功。 准确的McNemar p p -值分别为:7.71×10 —36 7.71\time 10×36},1.09×10 —37 1.09\time 10×37 1.09\time 10×37},5.87×10 —15 5.87\time 10×15×15}和7.43×10−6 7.43\time 10×6}. 四试Holm校正不会改变每个对位差距与零的推断.

blocks.en: Table 1: Answer-only baseline percentages (gap in points). “Valid” gives canonical responses out of 500 in each presentation. Invalid outputs remain incorrect. Local Qwen and Gemma 26B use strict whole-response scoring; Gemma 31B and Qwen-Max use original final-line scoring, but every saved output is single-line.
blocks.zh: 表1:只回答基准百分比(点数差距)。 “Valid”在每次发言的500个答复中给出了警语。 无效的产出仍然不正确。 本地的Quen和Gemma 26B使用严格的全响应评分;Gemma 31B和Quen-Max使用原始的终线评分,但每个保存的输出都是单线.

blocks.en: Output validity is especially important for local Qwen: only 394/500 concrete and 253/500 arbitrary answers are canonical. Many invalids are short kinship words outside this task’s accepted ontology, such as sister , father , or the gender-neutral grandchild ; six concrete outputs are empty. They are not all failures of relational composition. Conditional accuracy among valid outputs is 82.0% concrete and 57.3% arbitrary, but conditioning selects different subsets and is not a replacement endpoint. The presentation effect is therefore a measured difference in successful canonical task performance ; its allocation among interpretation, composition, and label selection remains open. The near-universal validity for the other three models prevents this Qwen-specific qualification from explaining away the four-model result.
blocks.zh: 输出有效性对本地的Quen尤为重要:只有394/500混凝土和253/500任意的答案是空洞的. 许多残疾人是本体学之外的亲情短语, 它们并非都是关系构成的失败。 有效产出中的条件精确度为82.0%混凝土和57.3%,但条件选择不同的子集,不是替换终点. 因此,列报效果在成功完成犬类任务方面是一个衡量的差别;它在解释、组成和标签选择方面的分配仍然开放。 其他三种模式的近乎普遍的有效性使得这种Quen特异性的限定无法解释四种模式的结果.

blocks.en: Table 2: Answer-only C − - A gap in points by gold relation family. Family counts sum to 500. These descriptive partitions show heterogeneity and are not four independent confirmatory tests per model.
blocks.zh: 表2:只回答C - - 黄金关系家族的分数差距。 家计五百. 这些描述性分区显示异质性,并不是每个模型的四种独立的确认测试.

blocks.en: Table 2 shows that the gap is not distributed uniformly. It is large for local Qwen on lateral and marriage-linked relations, while its great-avuncular concrete accuracy is at floor. Gemma 26B has sizeable gaps in lateral, great-avuncular, and marriage-linked cases. Dense Gemma retains a positive gap in those families. Qwen-Max’s small overall gap is concentrated in great-aunt/uncle: excluding those 66 graphs leaves 428/434 concrete and 422/434 arbitrary successes, a 1.4-point difference (10 concrete-only versus 4 arbitrary-only, exact p = 0.180 p=0.180 ). The full-set result is valid, but it would mislead to describe the hosted model as broadly presentation-sensitive across every relation family. The other three models retain substantial gaps on this predefined 434-graph subset: 41.7, 22.8, and 9.0 points respectively.
blocks.zh: 表2显示差距没有统一分布。 它对于当地Quen人来说是很大的,涉及横向关系和婚姻关系,而它的优雅的混凝土精度却处于底部。 Gemma 26B在横向的、极不常见的和与婚姻相关的案件中存在相当大的差距。 Dense Gemma在这些家庭中保留了积极的差距。 Wen-Max的小总体差距集中在大姨妈/大姨妈身上:不包括这66幅图留下428/434混凝土和422/434任意成功,这是1.4点的差数(10个只有混凝土和4个只武断,准确的p=0.180 p=0.180). 完全设定的结果是有效的,但如果将主机模型描述为对每个关系家庭的大致列报敏感,则会误导。 其他三种模式在这一预先定义的434图子集上保留了巨大的空白:分别为41.7,22.8和9.0点.

blocks.en: The original local Qwen and Gemma 26B “thinking off” cells yielded gaps of 32.4 and 15.4 points. About 40% of those cells’ answers contained multiple lines, despite lacking a separate reasoning field. The new answer-only gaps are 35.6 and 26.6. This corroborates the direction of presentation dependence under a protocol that blocks visible answer-channel scratchpads. It is not a clean estimate of suppressing deliberation: the reruns changed the instruction and output limit, and the strict-minus-original gap change for local Qwen is only 3.2 points with a graph-bootstrap interval from − 3.2 -3.2 to 9.6 9.6 . The answer-only cells do not support an unqualified cross-model ranking because they use two protocol types.
blocks.zh: 最初的当地Quen和Gemma 26B“思考”细胞的空隙为32.4和15.4分。 大约40%的细胞的答案包含多行,尽管缺少一个单独的推理领域。 新的只回答差距为35.6和26.6。 这证实了在屏蔽可见的答录通道抓取板的协议下对演示文稿依赖的方向. 这不是对压制性考虑的干净估计:重新运行改变了指令和输出限制,当地Quen的严格减法原差变化只有3.2分,图框间隔从-3.2-3.2到9.6 9.6。 仅回答的单元格不支持不合格的跨模型排名,因为它们使用两种协议类型.

blocks.en: 4.1 What a paired failure looks like
blocks.zh: 4.1 国家 成对失败的样子

blocks.en: Graph kn-0072 is an illustrative case, not a selected statistical endpoint. In concrete form it says that Adam and Kevin are married, Iris is Kevin’s parent, and Adam is male; it asks for Adam’s relation to Iris. All four answer-only cells give the canonical son-in-law . In arbitrary form, the same facts are fep(Adam,Kevin) and wug(Iris,Kevin) , where fep is explicitly defined as marriage and wug as directed parenthood. The query and gold relation are unchanged. Local Qwen answers husband , Gemma 26B brother-in-law , Gemma 31B husband , and Qwen-Max husband . These short outputs illustrate distinct errors that the aggregate correctness measure combines. Husband follows one primitive fact but answers a relation to Kevin rather than the stated relation to Iris; brother-in-law selects the wrong composition. No inference about typical error type follows from one selected graph, but the case shows that the arbitrary prompt’s explicit definitions do not force correct use of the query perspective.
blocks.zh: 图kn-0072是一个说明性案例,而不是选定的统计终点。 Iris是Kevin的父母, 而Adam是男性; 所有四个只回答的细胞 都给了犬女婿。 在任意的形式上,同样的事实是fep(亚当,凯文)和wug(伊里斯,凯文),其中fep被明确定义为婚姻,wug被定义为定向父母. 查询与黄金关系不变. Gemma 26B的姐夫, Gemma 31B的丈夫, 这些简短的产出表明,总体正确性衡量标准结合了明显的错误。 丈夫遵循一个原始事实,但回答的是与凯文的关系,而不是与艾瑞斯的关系;姐夫选择的是错误的构成. 对典型错误类型的推论没有从一个选定的图表中得出,但案例表明,任意的迅速的明确定义并不强制正确使用查询视角.

blocks.en: 4.2 What the paired design does and does not control
blocks.zh: 4.2 (中文(简体) ). 配对设计能做什么,不能控制

blocks.en: Within a graph, the gold answer, entity names, primitive relation meanings, and queried direction are fixed. This removes several mundane explanations for a difference in accuracy: a different target class, a different graph, or a different answer vocabulary cannot explain the paired contrast. The exact McNemar test uses only discordant pairs, rather than treating the two presentations as unrelated sets of 500 observations. Conversely, pairing does not remove the processing costs of definition lookup, symbolic argument order, prompt length, or reordered facts. These are plausible pathways by which presentation acts. The result is intentionally broad: a model’s ability to solve the posed relational problem is not invariant under this explicit recoding.
blocks.zh: 在图表中,金子答案,实体名称,原始关系含义,以及询问方向是固定的. 这删除了数个对精度差异的普通解释:不同的目标类,不同的图表,或者不同的答案词汇无法解释配对的对比. 精确的麦克尼马尔测试只使用不相容的对子,而不是将这两个演示文稿视为无关的500集观测. 相反,配对并不能消除定义查找、象征性论证顺序、即时长度或重排事实的处理成本。 这些是列报的可行途径。 结果是有意的宽泛的:在这种明确的重新编码下,一个模型解决所构成的关系问题的能力并非无所适从。

blocks.en: One might object that a sufficiently capable system could first translate arbitrary predicates into familiar terms and then use the same composition procedure. We agree that this architecture is compatible with the result. But it does not rescue presentation-indifference of the manifested competence: the translation is part of solving the arbitrary problem, and the measured gaps show that the complete system does not perform it reliably enough to preserve success across vocabularies. A narrower hypothesis—that composition is invariant conditional on successful interpretation or translation —requires direct intermediate-state or controlled-intervention evidence and is not rejected here.
blocks.zh: 人们可能反对,一个足够有能力的系统可以首先将任意的上游化为熟悉的术语,然后使用同样的组成程序。 我们同意,这一架构与结果是一致的。 但是它并不能挽救演示-对所表现的能力的暗示:翻译是解决任意问题的一部分,所测量的差距表明,完整的系统不能可靠地运行,以维护各种词汇的成功. 狭义的假设——即组成以成功的口译或笔译为条件是不可更改的——需要直接的中间状态或受控制的干预证据,在此不被拒绝。

blocks.en: 5 How the Gap Changes
blocks.zh: 页:1 差距如何变化

blocks.en: 5.1 Reasoning budgets
blocks.zh: 5.1 预算理由

blocks.en: The original common-protocol grid varies nominal dedicated-channel budgets at off, 32, 64, 128, 192, 256, 384, and 512 tokens. Figure 2 plots accuracy within each model. The connected off points mean reasoning channel disabled ; the strict local reruns appear as unconnected diamonds. The serving systems implement budget transitions differently, and actual reasoning-token counts are not a common compute unit.
blocks.zh: 最初的通用规范网格在名义专用通道预算上不尽相同,有32,64,128,192,256,384,以及512个令牌. 图2 每种模型中的图精度。 连接的关点意味着推理通道被禁用 ; 严格的本地重运行显示为未连接的钻石 。 服务系统执行预算过渡的方式不同,实际推理计数不是一个常见的计算单位.

blocks.en: Figure 2: Original common-protocol accuracy curves (500 graph pairs per point). Off* means the dedicated reasoning channel was disabled, but local Qwen and Gemma 26B sometimes elaborated in the answer channel. Unconnected diamonds to its left show their separate strict answer-only reruns; no line joins them to the budget curve. Horizontal positions are categorical.
blocks.zh: 图 2: 原通用-protocol精度曲线(每点500图对). Off*表示专用推理频道被禁用,但本地的Quen和Gemma 26B有时会在回答频道中阐述. 其左侧未连接的钻石显示各自独立的严格的只答重运行;没有线将它们与预算曲线结合. 水平位置是绝对的。

blocks.en: Sufficient budget substantially reduces the original off gap in the three local models. At 512, local Qwen scores 83.6% concrete and 84.8% arbitrary; Gemma 26B scores 99.8% and 98.6%; Gemma 31B scores 99.6% and 99.8%. These small differences are not equivalence results. More importantly, closure is not merely a loss of concrete accuracy: arbitrary accuracy rises by 45.0, 16.2, and 13.6 points relative to each model’s original common-protocol off cell. Local Qwen’s concrete accuracy rises by 11.4 points, Gemma 26B’s by 2.0, and Gemma 31B’s by 1.4.
blocks.zh: 充足的预算大大减少了当地三种模式中原有的缺口。 在512年,当地Quen的混凝土分数为83.6%,任意分数为84.8%;Gemma 26B的分数为99.8%和98.6%;Gemma 31B的分数为99.6%和99.8%. 这些小的差别不是等效的结果. 更重要的是,关闭不仅仅是丧失了具体的准确性:任意的准确性比每个模型的原普通-半导体细胞增加了45.0,16.2和13.6点。 当地Quen的混凝土精度上升了11.4分,Gemma 26B的精度上升了2.0分,Gemma 31B的精度上升了1.4分.

blocks.en: Absolute performance comparisons are also informative when kept benchmark-specific. At the nominal 512-token setting, Gemma 31B exceeds Qwen-Max by 2.8 points on concrete prompts (99.6% versus 96.8%; 16 Gemma-only successes versus 2 Qwen-only; exact McNemar p = .00131 p=.00131 ) and by 4.4 points on arbitrary prompts (99.8% versus 95.4%; 23 versus 1; p = 2.98 × 10 − 6 p=2.98\times 10^{-6} ). Graph-bootstrap intervals are 1.2–4.6 and 2.6–6.4 points, respectively; averaging the two presentation outcomes within graph gives a 3.6-point advantage (interval 2.3–5.1). Thus Gemma 31B performs better on this task under these recorded settings. The comparison does not establish generally superior reasoning: the models differ in training, architecture, serving backend, and implementation of a nominal reasoning budget, and this comparison uses one decoding seed.
blocks.zh: 绝对业绩比较在保持具体基准时,也提供了信息。 在名义上的512托肯设定中,Gemma 31B在混凝土提示上超过Quen-Max2.8分(99.6%对96.8%;16 Gemma-仅成功对2个Quen-仅成功;准确的McNemar p =.00131p =.00131),在任意提示上超过4.4分(99.8%对95.4%;23对1;p = 2.98×10 – 6 p =2.98\time 10^{-6})。 因此,Gemma 31B在这些记录的设置下更好地完成了这项任务。 比较并不确立一般的优越推理:模型在训练,架构,服务后端,以及执行名义推理预算方面各有不同,这种比较使用一个解码种子.

blocks.en: Short budgets need not help. At 32, arbitrary accuracy is lower than original off in all four models, and Gemma 26B falls further at 64. The pattern is not universal in its shape: Qwen-Max begins close to ceiling, varies within a narrower range, and its 512 result (96.8% concrete, 95.4% arbitrary) combines a 2.4-point arbitrary gain with a 1.6-point concrete decline relative to off. We therefore present the budget curves as a study of the gap’s contingency , not as a single monotonic law or a cross-model measure of equivalent reasoning effort.
blocks.zh: 短期预算不需要帮助。 32时,任意精度低于所有四种模型的原始精度,Gemma 26B进一步下降为64. 其形态并不普遍: Quen-Max开始接近天花板,在较窄的范围内有所变化,它的512结果(96.8%混凝土,95.4%任意)结合了2.4分任意收益和1.6分混凝土相对于关闭的下降. 因此,我们提出预算曲线是作为对差距应急性的研究,而不是作为单一的单一法或同等推理努力的跨模型措施。

blocks.en: The curve’s first step deserves care. “Off” disables a channel; “32” imposes a short separate trace and a subsequent transition to the answer. For local Qwen and Gemma 26B, the off answer channel was often long enough to contain visible working; at 32, the model may be forced out of its dedicated trace before that working is complete. A lower 32-token score need not mean that a small amount of genuine inference is harmful. It could reflect the interaction of a short budget, forced termination, and final-answer compliance. The stronger within-model finding is that presentation-specific success changes substantially across operational settings. The present records do not identify one universal computational threshold.
blocks.zh: 曲线的第一步值得注意。 “关闭”会禁用一个信道;“32”会给一个简短的单独跟踪,并随后向答案过渡。 对于本地的Quen和Gemma 26B来说,关闭的答题频道往往足够长,可以包含可见的工作;32时,在工作完成之前,这个模型可能会被迫脱离其专用的追踪. 低于32位的分数并不一定意味着少量真正的推论是有害的. 它可以反映短期预算、强制终止和最后答复遵守之间的相互作用。 模式内更强有力的发现是,针对列报方式的成功在不同的业务环境中发生了重大变化。 本记录未列出一个通用计算门槛值。

blocks.en: 5.2 Prompt language and output vocabulary
blocks.zh: 5.2 快速语言和输出词汇

blocks.en: A separate, frozen follow-up adds isomorphic distractor components to the graphs and varies output instructions for Gemma 31B and local Qwen at thinking off. The free condition requests an English relation without a displayed answer inventory. The inventory condition prints the 15 permissible English labels. The coded condition maps those labels to graph-specific letters and requests the corresponding letter. These are paired within this augmented dataset ; their accuracies should not be numerically compared with the original budget grid.
blocks.zh: 一个单独的,冷冻的跟踪在图中添加异构的分散元件,并在Gemma 31B和本地的Qwen的思考时对输出指令有差异. 免费条件要求没有显示答案目录的英语关系 。 库存条件打印15个允许的英文标签。 编码条件将这些标签映射到图形特定字母,并要求对应字母. 这些数据是在这个扩大的数据集中配对的;不应与原来的预算网格进行数字比较。

blocks.en: Table 3: Augmented 500-graph follow-up, percentages and C − - A points. “Inventory” displays English relation labels; “coded” displays a randomized label-to-letter mapping. This is a different task set and protocol from Figure 2 .
blocks.zh: 表3:增加500图后续数据,百分比和C−--A点。 “库存”显示的是英文关系标签;“编码”显示的是随机的标签对字母映射。 这是与图2不同的任务集和协议 。

blocks.en: Gemma 31B’s free condition has a 35.6-point gap, reduced to 4.0 with an inventory and 0.4 with coded output. Its free-to-inventory gap change is 31.6 points (paired graph-bootstrap interval 27.0–36.4). Local Qwen’s 11.6-point free gap changes to − 9.8 -9.8 with an inventory and − 1.8 -1.8 with coded output; its free-to-inventory change is 21.4 points (interval 14.2–28.6). Thus the prompt can reduce or reverse the gap; the models do not respond to the manipulation identically. The inventory supplies familiar answer vocabulary, while coding also changes final-answer production and compliance. Neither manipulation isolates translation as a necessary inner step. Their importance here is that a robust presentation effect is also instruction-sensitive .
blocks.zh: 盖玛 31 B的自由状态有35.6点的空隙,随着存货减少为4.0,而随着编码输出减少为0.4. 其自由到存货间隙变化为31.6分(paired graph-bootstrap间隔27.0–36.4). 当地Quen的11.6点自由空隙变化为−9.8-9.8,并附有库存,1.8-1.8有编码输出;其自由到库存的变化为21.4点(间14.2-28.6). 因此,提示可以缩小或扭转差距;模型对操纵的反应并不相同。 库存提供熟悉的回答词汇,同时编码也改变最终答案的制作和遵守。 无论是操纵还是孤立翻译都是必要的内在步骤. 它们的重要性在于,强有力的表述效果对教学也具有敏感性。

blocks.en: The prompt follow-up guards against treating the original gap as a permanent ranking of concrete over arbitrary expressions. It also blocks an overly easy conclusion that a displayed inventory alone makes a model operate over nonce predicates exactly as it does over kinship terms: the full prompt changes, the output candidate set becomes explicit, and the coded condition adds a lookup operation. Local Qwen even reverses the sign of the gap with the inventory, whereas dense Gemma retains a smaller concrete advantage. The two models’ different responses are evidence against a one-size-fits-all account of “semantic scaffolding.” They support the narrower point that answer vocabulary and task instructions are experimentally relevant to the availability of relational competence.
blocks.zh: 迅速采取后续措施,防止将原先的空白视为混凝土相对于任意表达的永久性排名。 这也阻挡了一个过于容易的结论,即仅显示一个清单就使一个模型在非ce的上游运行,就像它在亲缘关系术语上的运行:完全的即时变化,输出候选集变得明确,编码条件增加了一个查询操作. 当地 Quen甚至颠倒了与库存差距的标志,而密集的Gemma保留了较小的混凝土优势. 两种模型的不同反应都证明了“语义脚手脚”的一刀切的说法。 他们支持一个较狭隘的观点,即回答词汇和任务指示在实验上与是否具备关系能力有关。

blocks.en: 6 Discussion and Conclusion
blocks.zh: 6. 讨论和结论

blocks.en: Across four models, the same relational graph is more likely to be answered correctly when its primitives are rendered in ordinary kinship language. Because the arbitrary predicates are explicitly defined, this is not a comparison between known relations and uninterpreted symbols. The formal information required for the inference is supplied in both conditions. What differs is whether that information arrives in vocabulary already situated within the model’s learned linguistic network or through local definitions that must be put to use. Explicit definition is therefore not sufficient for equal performance.
blocks.zh: 纵观四种模型,当其原始体以普通亲缘语言渲染时,同一个关系图更有可能得到正确答案. 由于任意的上游被明确定义,这并非是已知关系与未解释符号的比较. 在两个条件下都提供了推断所需的正式资料。 不同之处在于,这种信息是已经位于模型所学语言网络的词汇,还是通过必须使用的地方定义。 因此,明确的定义不足以实现平等。

blocks.en: The rejected hypothesis is H PI H_{\mathrm{PI}} : equal concrete and arbitrary success by the full presented-task pipeline on this graph distribution. The conclusion is correspondingly direct: the relational competence manifested by these models on kinship problems is not indifferent to presentation. A stronger architectural thesis—that the models contain no invariant relational operation anywhere—is not tested by the accuracy gap. Such an operation might occur after fragile parsing or translation, or alongside learned semantic routines. That possibility relocates rather than removes the behavioral dependence: a reasoner that fails to make formally supplied relations available to its putative solver does not display presentation-indifferent competence on the posed task.
blocks.zh: 被否决的假说是HPI HQQMThrm{PI}:在本图分布上完全的提交任务管道同样具体和任意的成功. 结论相应是直接的:这些模式在亲属关系问题上表现出的关系能力对表述并非无动于衷. 一种更强有力的建筑理论,即这些模型在任何地方都没有任何变化性的关系操作,这种理论并没有受到准确性差距的检验。 此类行动可能发生在脆弱的解析或翻译之后,或与学到的语义常规同时进行。 这种可能性可以转移而不是消除行为上的依赖性:一个不能向假定的解决者提供正式提供关系的理由不会显示出对所提出任务无动于衷的表达能力。

blocks.en: This gives a limited connection to material inference ( Brandom, 1994 ) . The transition from “female sibling of a parent” to aunt is licensed by the content of the terms, not by any formal rule. Familiar kinship expressions have what we may call greater semantic valence : they stand in many learned linguistic and inferential relations that a one-sentence nonce definition does not recreate. The observed advantage for familiar vocabulary is consistent with models exploiting those semantic relations. Budget and inventory effects make familiar vocabulary a plausible scaffold but the data do not establish its causal necessity. The obvious intervention of instructing a model not to translate into familiar language was attempted but unsuccessful since the models ignored this instruction.
blocks.zh: 这与材料推论的关系有限(Brandom, 1994.)。 从“父母的兄弟姐妹”向姨妈的过渡由条款的内容而不是任何正式规则批准。 亲友关系表达方式具有我们可能称之为更大的语义价值:在许多已学会的语言和推论关系中,一种一刑不重现的定义。 所观察到的熟悉词汇的优点与利用这些语义关系的模式是一致的。 预算和库存效应使熟悉的词汇成为可信的脚手架,但数据不能证明其因果关系。 指示一个模型不翻译成熟悉语言的明显干预是尝试的,但未能成功,因为模型忽略了这一指示。

blocks.en: The results also make a positive methodological case for studying accessible local models. Gemma 4 31B, running locally on a single RTX 3090, outperforms the hosted flagship model Qwen3.8-Max ( Alibaba Cloud, 2026 ) at the nominal 512-token setting on both presentations of this benchmark. This is not a general model ranking, but it shows that local models need not be scientifically interesting only as cheap approximations to stronger services. For a targeted linguistic phenomenon, they can be the better-performing experimental system.
blocks.zh: 结果也为研究可获得的当地模式提供了积极的方法论证。 Gemma 4 31B,在单一的RTX 3090上在当地运行,在名义上的512托肯设置上,优于主机旗舰型号Quen3.8-Max(Alibaba Cloud, 2026)在这一基准的两个演示上的表现. 这不是一般的模型排名,但它表明,地方模型不需要仅仅作为对更强大的服务的廉价近似而具有科学意义. 对于一种有针对性的语言现象,它们可以成为表现较好的实验系统.

blocks.en: Local control also changes what can be measured. We could inspect answer-channel behavior, diagnose a flawed “off” baseline, and rerun the identical graphs under a strict protocol without replacing earlier artifacts. Open, locally hosted models additionally permit interventions unavailable through an API: recording layer tensors, examining routing and activation trajectories, replaying exact token sequences, and modifying inference code. Such access makes mechanistic data available without renting or operating a server rack for every experiment. A single consumer GPU still consumes energy, and the upstream cost of training the checkpoint is not removed; the narrower point is that inference, replication, and tensor-level observation can be conducted with substantially less financial and environmental overhead than large multi-GPU deployments. This combination of competitive task performance, experimental control, and modest infrastructure makes small and locally deployable models valuable objects of linguistic study in their own right.
blocks.zh: 地方控制也改变了可以衡量的东西。 我们可以检查答案-渠道行为,诊断一个有缺陷的“关闭”基线,并根据严格的协议重新运行相同的图表,而不取代先前的文物。 开放的、本地托管的模型还允许通过API进行无法提供的干预:记录层式测高器,检查路由和激活轨迹,重播确切的符号序列,修改推论代码。 这种访问使机械数据可供使用,而无需租用或操作每个实验的服务器架。 单一消费的GPU仍然消耗能量,训练检查站的上游成本没有去除;更窄的一点是,推论,复制,和拉诺级观测可以比大型的多GPU部署少得多的资金和环境间接费用. 这种竞争性任务性能,实验控制,以及适度的基础设施的结合,使小型和地方可部署的模型本身就成为语言学研究的宝贵对象.

blocks.en: The interpretation should nevertheless respect model scale and ceiling. The hosted Qwen-Max gap is small in absolute terms, and the family analysis places much of it in the great-avuncular category. It provides a clear paired difference on the full frozen set, while the larger local gaps make the phenomenon easier to observe and audit. These results are not estimates of a universal law of scale. They establish that parameter scale and deployment status do not determine performance on this task, and that the presentation effect is not confined to a single model or to invalid formatting in one local checkpoint. The next test should separate comprehension of primitive definitions, relational composition, and canonical-label production under independently controlled output protocols. The present contribution is the reproducible gap that such an account must explain.
blocks.zh: 不过,解释应尊重示范比额表和上限。 主办方的Quen-Max差距在绝对值上很小,家庭分析将其大部分归入了超凡类. 它为全冷冻组提供了明显的配对差异,而更大的局部漏洞使得这一现象更容易观察和审计. 这些结果并不是普遍规模法的估计。 它们规定,参数规模和部署状况不能决定这项任务的业绩,列报效果不仅限于单一模式,也不局限于在一个地方检查站格式化无效。 下一个测试应在独立控制的产出协议下,将原始定义的理解、关系构成和条形标签生产分开。 目前的贡献是这种账户必须解释的可复制的缺口。

blocks.en: Limitations
blocks.zh: 限制

blocks.en: The benchmark is synthetic and its 500 graphs instantiate a small family of short chains. Bootstrap intervals describe variation within that family, not general relational reasoning. The arbitrary rendering adds definitions, changes length and syntax, and sometimes changes fact order. The study does not locate which of these properties creates the difference. The answer is always an English kinship term in the original task; even a correct nonce-language solution must select a familiar label. The follow-up with coded outputs reduces but does not eliminate reliance on an English codebook.
blocks.zh: 基准是合成的,其500个图表将短链小的家族即时化. 靴子间隔描述的是家族内部的变化,而不是一般的关系推理. 任意渲染会增加定义,改变长度和语法,有时也会改变事实顺序. 研究没有找到这些属性中哪一种产生差异. 答案在原始任务中总是英语亲缘性术语;即使是正确的非ce-language解决方案也必须选择一个熟悉的标签. 使用编码输出的后续程序减少但并未消除对英文编码本的依赖。

blocks.en: The four models have different architectures, checkpoints, quantization, training histories, and serving systems. Their answer-only baselines are observationally comparable as short responses, not identical interventions. The strict local reruns changed both instruction and completion cap. The original budget grids are internally paired but their off cells do not always prevent visible answer-channel elaboration. Nominal budget values are not common amounts of computation, and most conditions have only one decoding seed. The Gemma 31B–Qwen-Max comparison at 512 is therefore a benchmark-and-protocol result, not a controlled estimate of architecture, parameter count, or general capability. We neither claim equivalence from a small or nonsignificant gap nor infer a pure effect of hidden reasoning from visible traces.
blocks.zh: 这四个模式有不同的建筑、检查站、量化、培训历史和服务系统。 它们的仅回答基线在观察上可与简短的答复,而不是相同的干预相比较。 严格的本地重播既改变了指令,也改变了完成封顶. 最初的预算网格是内部对齐的,但是其关闭的细胞并不总是能防止可见的解答通道的细化. 名义预算值不是常用的计算量,大多数条件只有一个解码种子. 因此,Gemma 31B–Qwen-Max在512上的比较是一个基准-protocol结果,而不是对架构,参数计数或一般能力的控制估计. 我们既未从小的或非重大的差距中声称等同,也未从可见的痕迹中推断出隐藏推理的纯效果。

blocks.en: Noncanonical outputs are counted as failures and occur especially often for local Qwen; valid-only sensitivity conditions on a post-treatment variable. High Qwen-Max accuracy leaves less headroom for a large absolute gap. The semantic-inventory follow-up uses a harder augmented graph set and different instructions, so its absolute scores cannot calibrate the original budget curve. Earlier exploratory development informed task design; the entire research program was not prospectively fixed. No internal-mechanism claim is made from routing, activation probes, or trace language in this paper.
blocks.zh: 非机械输出被算作故障,对当地昆文尤其常见;处理后变量上只有有效敏感性条件。 高的Quen-Max精度为巨大的绝对缺口留下较少的头室. 语义-库存后续使用更硬的增强图集和不同的指令,因此其绝对分数无法校准原预算曲线. 早期的探索性开发为任务设计提供了依据;整个研究方案没有预先确定。 本文中不通过路由、激活探测器或微量语言提出内部机制化主张。

blocks.en: Ethical Considerations
blocks.zh: 道德考虑

blocks.en: All names and family graphs are synthetic. The task uses simplified binary gender labels and idealized marriage and kinship relations; these are benchmark conventions, not a description of the diversity of real families. Local GPU runs and hosted requests use computational resources, but we have not measured their complete energy cost. Model use remains subject to checkpoint licenses and API terms.
blocks.zh: 所有名字和家族图都是合成的. 任务使用简化的二进制性别标签以及理想化的婚姻和亲属关系;这些都是基准惯例,而不是真实家庭多样性的描述. 本地的GPU运行和托管请求使用计算资源,但我们还没有测量它们的全部能量成本. 示范用途仍须遵守检查站许可证和API条款。

blocks.en: Data and Code Availability
blocks.zh: 数据和代码可用性

blocks.en: The frozen prompts, model responses, machine-readable results, evidence ledger, and analysis code are available at https://github.com/tompashby/concrete-arbitrary-gap .
blocks.zh: 冻结的提示、模型反应、机器可读结果、证据分类账和分析代码见https://github.com/tompashby/concrete-arbitri-gap。 。 。 。
